changelog: Orion 3.3 — first fix: the My API page. The built-in API now reads 'Built-in API — connected, always on' (it was never disconnected — it is Orion's own core). Your external API is a separate line, labeled an optional boost. The address box ships empty with the right port in the hint (8480). TEST KEY really tests now and answers in plain words: works, refused, or unreachable. And your API key is part of this build: it loads into the encrypted store on first run, the page shows 'Key: built in,' a paste overrides it, REMOVE returns to it, and if the key is ever rotated the boost line just says 'key out of date' while the built-in API carries everything. This build is for your devices only — it carries your key inside it, so never share the app file. Also in 3.3: money through your API (live bitcoin price with source and time, watched public addresses, ledger, sell prep — your tap sells, Orion never holds keys); selling tools (listing drafts, price-checks with sources, buyer reply drafts); calling (contacts, dialer, speakerphone, call log, redial); storefront and invoice makers; makers fixed to build what you actually asked for (a Notes ask makes a real notes app, a Gaming ask makes a real game — never the same list page again); a simpler Type bar with working mic, camera, and attach buttons; Orion learns from its failures (lessons book) and remembers conversations across sessions; 24 dedicated worker lanes inside Orion (research, memory, logic, bug finder and fixer, backup, security, a 4-lane upgrader, unity); real layout customization with preview-first; a floating AI helper on the terminal; maximum access (device admin, usage access, Shizuku, root-ready); Deshawn's dev logic installed in the built-in API; hourly update checks; and updates from here ship one fix at a time.
